thesis: Quantum physics has precise successes and plural interpretations; its strangeness does not prove spirituality.

ideas.statement: Planck, Bohr, Heisenberg, Pauli, Bohm and Schrödinger held distinct philosophical concerns that cannot be added as confirmations of one theology.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Observer does not entail consciousness creating reality, randomness does not entail agency, complementarity does not sanction contradictions, and quotation provenance remains qualified.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Observer does not entail consciousness creating reality, randomness does not entail agency, complementarity does not sanction contradictions, and quotation provenance remains qualified.

audit.notes: All batch source units read; scientific propositions separated from philosophical interpretations and documentary limits.
